notes.subject: Elohim
notes.rationale: Ves i no tokim man i wokim; subjek i kamap long Stat 105 antap — bracket o no bracket i hat, mi putim

notes.subject: ויעצמהו מצריו
notes.rationale: עצם (strong) na מצר (birua/traipela ples narapela) — ol man i strong long ol man bilong Mitsrayim

translation: Na Elohim i givim ⟨את⟩ ol manmeri bilong em i go het planti tru, na i mekim ol i strongpela moa long ol birua bilong ol.

tokens.gloss: Na … i givim … i go het
na i mekim ol i strongpela
moa long ol birua bilong ol
